mapper.sql: select a.id, a.url, a.domain, a.title, a.author, a.publish_time, a.cover_image, a.favicon, a.summary, a.tags, a.category, a.fetch_status, a.fetch_error, a.ai_status, a.ai_error, a.ai_model, a.read_flag, a.star_flag, a.source, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from px_web_article a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.url, a.domain, a.title, a.author, a.publish_time, a.cover_image, a.favicon, a.content_text, a.content_html, a.summary, a.tags, a.category, a.fetch_status, a.fetch_error, a.ai_status, a.ai_error, a.ai_model, a.read_flag, a.star_flag, a.source, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from px_web_article a where a.id = #{id} and a.del_flag = '0'
and a.create_by = #{userId}
where a.url_hash = #{urlHash} and a.create_by = #{userId} and a.del_flag = '0' limit 1
select distinct a.tags from px_web_article a where a.create_by = #{userId} and a.del_flag = '0' and a.tags is not null and a.tags != ''
mapper.insert: insert into px_web_article(url, url_hash, domain, title, fetch_status, ai_status, read_flag, star_flag, source, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{url}, #{urlHash}, #{domain}, #{title}, #{fetchStatus}, #{aiStatus}, '0', '0', #{source}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update px_web_article set domain = #{domain}, title = #{title}, author = #{author}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, favicon = #{favicon}, content_text = #{contentText}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, fetch_status = #{fetchStatus}, fetch_error = #{fetchError}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}

update px_web_article set summary = #{summary}, tags = #{tags}, category = #{category}, ai_status = #{aiStatus}, ai_error = #{aiError}, ai_model = #{aiModel}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}

update px_web_article set fetch_status = '0', fetch_error = null, ai_status = '0', ai_error = null, retry_count = 0, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and create_by = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update px_web_article set ai_status = '0', ai_error = null, retry_count = 0, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and create_by = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update px_web_article set read_flag = #{readFlag}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and create_by = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update px_web_article set star_flag = #{starFlag}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and create_by = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select a.id, a.url, a.create_by, a.fetch_status, a.ai_status from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.retry_count < #{maxRetry} and a.update_time < #{before} and ((a.fetch_status = '2') or (a.fetch_status = '1' and a.ai_status = '2')) order by a.update_time asc limit 20

select a.id, a.url, a.domain, a.title, a.author, a.publish_time, a.summary, a.tags, a.category, a.content_text, a.read_flag, a.star_flag, a.source, a.create_by, a.create_time from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_by = #{userId} order by a.create_time asc, a.id asc

select count(*) as total, sum(case when a.read_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unread, sum(case when a.star_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as starred, sum(case when a.fetch_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as fetch_success, sum(case when a.fetch_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as fetch_failed, sum(case when a.ai_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as ai_success, sum(case when a.ai_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as ai_failed, sum(case when a.source = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as from_rss, sum(case when a.read_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as readed from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_by = #{userId}

select a.category as name, count(*) as value from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_by = #{userId} and a.category is not null and a.category != '' group by a.category order by value desc

select date_format(a.create_time, '%m-%d') as date, count(*) as value from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_by = #{userId} and a.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(a.create_time, '%m-%d') order by date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') asc
select a.id, a.tags from px_web_article a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_by = #{userId} and a.tags is not null and a.tags != '' and find_in_set(#{tag}, a.tags)
mapper.update: update px_web_article set tags = #{tags}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and create_by = #{updateBy} and del_flag = '0'
